Usage:  circleci workflow rerun <workflow-id> [flags]

Flags:
      --from-failed        Rerun only failed jobs
  -h, --help               help for rerun
      --job stringArray    Rerun only this job, by name or ID (repeatable)
      --json               Output as JSON
      --no-wait            With --ssh, return without waiting for the ssh command
      --ssh                Enable SSH access to the rerun jobs (requires --job)
      --timeout duration   With --ssh, how long to wait for the ssh command (default 10m0s)
